name: Samira
title: the Desert Rose

Q.name: Flair
Q.description: Samira fires a shot, dealing 0/5/10/15/20 + 1.1×AD physical damage to the first enemy hit. If this Ability is cast towards an enemy in melee range, Samira will instead slash with her sword, dealing 0/5/10/15/20 + 1.1×AD physical damage.
Q.summary: Samira fires a shot or swings her sword, dealing damage. If cast during Wild Rush, strike all enemies in her path upon completion.

W.name: Blade Whirl
W.description: Samira slashes around her for 0.75 seconds, damaging enemies twice for 20/35/50/65/80 + 0.5×bonus AD physical damage each and destroying any enemy missiles that enter the area.
W.summary: Samira slashes around her, damaging enemies and destroying enemy missiles.

E.name: Wild Rush
E.description: Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through dealing 50/60/70/80/90 + 0.2×bonus AD magic damage and gaining 20/25/30/35/40% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. If an enemy champion is killed within 3 seconds of Samira damaging them, This Ability's Cooldown is reset.
E.summary: Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures), slashing enemies she passes through and gaining Attack Speed. Killing an enemy champion refreshes this ability's cooldown.

R.name: Inferno Trigger
R.description: Samira can only use this Ability if her current Style rating is S. Using this Ability consumes all Style rating. Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her 10 times over 2 seconds, each shot dealing 20/40/60 + 0.3×AD physical damage and applying Life Steal at 100% effectiveness. Each shot can also critically strike.
R.summary: Samira unleashes a torrent of shots from her weapons, wildly shooting all enemies surrounding her.

Passive.name: Daredevil Impulse
Passive.description: Samira builds a combo by hitting attacks or abilities unique from the previous hit. Samira's attacks in melee range deal additional magic damage. Samira's attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her attack range. If the enemy is Knocked Up, she also keeps them Knocked Up briefly.
Passive.summary: Samira builds a combo by hitting attacks or abilities unique from the previous hit. Samira's attacks in melee range deal additional magic damage. Samira's attacks against enemies affected by Immobilizing effects will dash her to her attack range. If the enemy is Knocked Up, she also keeps them Knocked Up briefly.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Samira is an aggressive marksman who builds style by hitting different attacks and abilities, then unleashes Inferno Trigger at S rank. She plays bot lane, dives with Wild Rush, and blocks enemy missiles with Blade Whirl.
strengths: Inferno Trigger deals huge area damage with life steal and can turn teamfights.
Blade Whirl destroys enemy missiles, blocking skillshots and ranged attacks.
Wild Rush resets on takedowns, so she can chain kills in teamfights.
Daredevil Impulse dashes her to immobilized targets, so she follows up on allied CC.
Strong all-in with an engage support.
weaknesses: Short range compared to other ADCs.
Weak against CC: she needs to be in close range to deal damage.
Inferno Trigger needs S rank style, so she must build combos first.
No escape apart from Wild Rush.
Struggles against poke and long-range ADCs.

curve.lvl1: okay – Q plus melee-range attacks, but she cannot all-in yet
curve.lvl2: good – W blocks the enemy support's skillshot during trades
curve.lvl3: strong – E dash lets her all-in with her support's CC
curve.lvl6: very strong – Inferno Trigger at S rank turns 2v2s
curve.items: strong – first item: Bloodthirster or Infinity Edge with Immortal Shieldbow
curve.late: strong – E resets on takedowns let her chain kills in teamfights

profile.curveNote: Samira wants E to all-in, and her real power is at 6 with Inferno Trigger.
profile.waveClear: Okay: Q and W clear waves.

keyAbilities.trading: E (Wild Rush) into Q and W combo

Passive.notes: Daredevil Impulse: builds style by hitting different attacks and abilities; dashes to immobilized targets.

Q.answer: Dodge sideways, or block with a projectile block.
Q.notes: Flair: a shot at range, or a sword slash in melee range.

W.notes: Blade Whirl: slashes around her and destroys enemy missiles.

E.notes: Wild Rush: dashes through an enemy, gaining attack speed; resets on takedowns.

R.notes: Inferno Trigger: shoots all enemies around her repeatedly with life steal; needs S rank style.

profile.windowAgainst: Samira's window is before she reaches S rank or when Wild Rush is on cooldown: she has no escape and less damage.
